players.bio: Alex Nahuel Luna (born 31 March 2004) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Instituto, on loan from Atlético de Rafaela. Club career Luna came through the youth ranks at Atlético de Rafaela, having joined at the age of nine from 9 de Julio. He scored sixteen goals in Rafaela's academy in 2019–20, finishing as their top scorer.

Daniel Walter Oldrá (born 15 March 1967) is an Argentine retired football coach and former player who played as a right-back or a centre back. He is the current manager of Instituto. Oldrá is considered one of the best central defenders in the history of Mendoza football.
Rodolfo Diego Flores (born 11 December 1980) is an Argentine football manager, and former player who played mainly as a midfielder. He is the current manager of Instituto.
Diego Alejandro Sosa (born 28 July 1997) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Tigre.

Fernando Rubén Alarcón (born 16 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División side Instituto. Career Alarcón moved into the Rosario Central first-team in May 2015, when he was an unused substitute for a Copa Argentina tie with Deportivo Riestra.

Franco Martín Díaz (born 28 August 2000) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Instituto (C) on loan from Vélez Sarsfield. Technical features He is a central midfielder. Career Raised in the youth sector of Temperley, he was loaned to Sp. Barracas in 2020, with whom he played his first professional match on February 26 against Gimnasia (LP) in the Copa Argentina.
Franco Daniel Jara (born 15 July 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.
Franco David Moyano (born 13 September 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentinos Juniors.

Giuliano Cerato (born 10 June 1998 in Rio Cuarto) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a right-back and his current team is Aldosivi of the First Division. Career With a stint in the youth ranks of Vélez Sarsfield, Cerato began his professional career at UAI Urquiza of the B Metropolitana. In December 2021, the player signed for Instituto de Córdoba in the Primera B.

Hernán de la Fuente (born 7 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Primera División club Huracán. Club career Vélez Sarsfield Born in Buenos Aires, de La Fuente started off with Vélez Sarsfield.

Juan Ignacio Méndez Aveiro (born 28 April 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Instituto, on loan from Newell's Old Boys. Career Club Méndez began in the youth system of Andes Talleres in 2005, where he spent seven years, trialling at Boca Juniors in 2009, before joining the ranks of Argentinos Juniors in 2012.

Jhon Emerson Córdoba Mosquera (born 15 July 2000 in Pereira) is a Colombian footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a winger in Instituto of the Argentine First Division. Trajectory Atlético Bucaramanga Jhon Emerson was part of the champion squad of the first star in the history of Atlético Bucaramanga.

Héctor Jonás Acevedo (born 6 February 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger or midfielder for Instituto. Career After youth spells with Atlético de Concarán, Sportivo Municipal and San Lorenzo, Acevedo began his senior career with San Lorenzo of the Argentine Primera División in 2018.

Jonathan Sebastián Galván (born 25 June 1992) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentinos Juniors. Career Galván began in the youth ranks of Primera B Nacional side Aldosivi, he was promoted into the club's first-team in 2011.

Juan Andrés Meli (born 1 September 2000 in Godoy Cruz) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a left back and his current team is Godoy Cruz of the Argentine First Division. Career Trained in the Godoy Cruz youth teams, Meli made his debut with the first team on September 18, 2021 in the 1-1 draw against Sarmiento.

Julio Leonel Mosevich (born 4 February 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cordoban club Instituto, on loan from Argentinos Juniors. Club career Mosevich's career started with Argentinos Juniors.
Juan Manuel Romero Báez (born May 5, 2001) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a forward for Instituto (C) on loan from Olimpia.
Marcos Ignacio Ledesma (born 15 September 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Gimnasia La Plata on loan from Defensa y Justicia.

Matias Fonseca (born 12 March 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División side Instituto. Born in Italy, he represented them at youth international level before switching his allegiance to Uruguay. Club career Born in Naples, Fonseca was formed as a player on Como and Inter Milan youth system.
Matías Valentín Gallardo (born 24 November 2003) is an Argentine footballer who currently plays as an attacking midfielder for Argentine Primera División side Instituto.
Nicolás Bastián Guerra Ruz (born 9 January 1999) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a forward for Chilean Primera División side Universidad de Chile.
